g.text: swap_router and fee_bps fixed at creation
a mock Jupiter, fixed at strategy creation

svg.text: first it values the fund: every vault balance × its fresh Pyth price,
in u128, multiply before divide. On the first deposit the NAV is zero
and shares mint one for one, so 900 USDC becomes 900 shares.
then it deploys at the weights: 40% of 900 buys TSLAx at $250 and
60% buys NVDAx at $180, both legs through the router fixed at
strategy creation. The USDC vault ends where it started, at zero.
and the program, not the manager, decides the acceptable price:
each leg’s minimum out is computed from the oracle feed and
floored by max_slippage_bps, so a bad fill reverts the deposit.
